releaseBlockingRegressions.observation: Portrait live composition and the Take photo action were simultaneously visible and usable without scrolling the preview out of view.
A newly saved capture rendered as a normal Gallery list thumbnail rather than a persistent black block.
Navigating from Camera to Gallery released the camera; the iOS camera-use indicator stopped instead of remaining active.
Denying camera permission displayed Permission denied without a Clawd overlay or false ready state. Restoring permission and retrying returned to a real camera preview and capture.
The installed PWA produced a landscape capture with 1439 x 1080 pixels, width greater than height, and no EXIF Orientation correction dependency.

nonBlockingNotes: In low-height landscape, the reachable sticky Take photo action overlays a large portion of the live composition. The control does not enter the captured image, but the layout should receive separately scoped mobile camera UX research and polish.
remainingManualCoverage: visible focus, contrast, 200 percent zoom, and text enlargement
